_comment: EXAMPLE of per-role model routes (FORGE-477); it is not loaded. Copy it to a file and point METAFORGE_MODEL_ROUTES_PATH at it to opt in, and only after the providers named here have credentials on that deployment. A route whose provider is not configured is refused at call time and reported by GET /v1/harness/routing and health.check. Each value is {provider, model}. Roles with no route use the durable harness selection. Single roles can also be set with METAFORGE_ROUTE_<ROLE>=provider:model (role upper-cased, ':' and '-' as '_'). A project can carry its own routes under projects.<project_id>.roles. Routes are checked at load with the provider/model family rule (FORGE-468).
